activities.name: Scouts Queensland — Joey Scouts (ages 5–8)
activities.description: Weekly section for 5–8 year olds: games, craft, day hikes and outdoor adventure skills. Find your local of 200+ Queensland groups via Scouts Queensland.
activities.price_note: Membership fees apply — check with your local group

activities.name: Scouts Queensland — Cub Scouts (ages 8–11)
activities.description: Weekly section for 8–11 year olds: camping, canoeing, navigation and bushwalks. Find your local group via Scouts Queensland.
activities.price_note: Membership fees apply — check with your local group

activities.name: Scouts Queensland — Scouts (ages 11–14)
activities.description: Weekly section for 11–14 year olds: expeditions, camp cooking and leadership skills. Find your local group via Scouts Queensland.
activities.price_note: Membership fees apply — check with your local group

activities.name: MiniRoos Kick-Off (ages 4–11)
activities.description: National introductory soccer program for boys and girls aged 4–11: 45–60 minute weekly sessions over 4–12 weeks. Find a club via Play Football.
activities.price_note: Registration fees vary by club — check with provider

activities.name: MiniRoos Club Football (ages 5–11)
activities.description: Team-based small-sided soccer (4v4, 7v7, 9v9) played in the winter season for ages 5–11. Find a club via Play Football.
activities.price_note: Registration fees vary by club — check with provider

activities.name: MiniRoos for Girls — MiniTillies (ages 4–11)
activities.description: Girls-only introductory soccer program for ages 4–11, run over 4–12 weeks. Find a program via Play Football.
activities.price_note: Registration fees vary by club — check with provider

activities.name: Basketball Queensland — junior domestic competitions
activities.description: Junior domestic basketball run by 43 affiliated associations across Queensland. Age groups and seasons vary by association — use the Basketball Queensland finder to contact your nearest one.
activities.price_note: Registration fees vary by association — check with provider

activities.name: Basketball Queensland — kids development programs (ages 4–9)
activities.description: Introductory basketball for kids aged 4–9: fundamental skills, teamwork and confidence through structured activities and modified games. Find a program via Basketball Queensland.
activities.price_note: Program fees vary by association — check with provider

activities.name: PCYC Queensland school holiday programs
activities.description: Half-day and full-day school holiday activity camps at PCYC clubs statewide — gymnastics, team games, laser tag, court sports and more. Program varies by club.

activities.name: YMCA Queensland school holiday programs
activities.description: School holiday programs run at YMCA community centres across south-east Queensland (e.g. Springfield Lakes, North Lakes, Mango Hill). Check your nearest centre for the current program.

activities.name: BCC Libraries — Brick builders code club (ages 8–12)
activities.description: Hands-on STEAM building sessions at Brisbane City Council libraries, usually in the school holidays. Some branches require bookings — check the council events page for current sessions.

activities.name: BCC Libraries — Make and create for kids (ages 4–12)
activities.description: Free drop-in art and craft sessions at Brisbane City Council libraries — no booking needed. Check the council events page for current sessions.

activities.name: Queensland Museum Kurilpa
activities.description: Queensland's state museum at South Bank, home to the Sciencentre's hands-on science exhibits.
activities.price_note: Free general entry; some exhibitions ticketed

activities.name: Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary
activities.description: Koala sanctuary on the Brisbane River with native Australian wildlife.
activities.price_note: Paid entry — see official site for prices

activities.description: Planetarium with astronomy shows and displays, in the Botanic Gardens at Mt Coot-tha.
